Question: How did you start your business on Amazon?
Old_Answer: I started my **Amazon Business** in 2014 accidentally, actually i was looking for online money-making ways and suddenly i got an advertisement about selling on **ebay** with the drop-shipping method. If you don’t know about Drop-shipping then let me explain, it’s a way where we sell the product without managing any inventory or product, and when we get an order then we purchase the same product from the vendor who offers the cheapest price with good quality. In the advertisement, there were training about how to drop-ship product from AMAZON to EBAY. Actually, i had to do research about hot selling products on amazon and try to find out some products which are selling on **Amazon** at very low cost in comparison to** eBay.** So i figure out some products where i can make a $1-$25 profit on each product, and then I listed the same product images on eBay from Amazon. And boom, i got many orders from Ebay, then i put all the shipping information of the customer from Ebay, and place the same order on Amazon with my customer’s shipping details and done. and I got my profit margin from Ebay, Now the twist came out… Finally, i put my mind on how to find good products which can be sold directly to eBay without using AMAZON Drop-shipping Strategy. As I don’t have anything to sell on **Amazon** so I went to my friend who was selling mobile accessories in his physical store. He suggested some items that were in demand and told me where i can find these products. now i had not enough money to invest and i went to the market with **Rs. 2500 only**, and i purchased some products with cost Rs. 50 to Rs.150 Per item only. Then I shoot the pictures on white paper and listed it on Ebay, That time I don’t know anything about **listings**, **UPC Codes, Product Ranking **, and so on. I learned all things from **Google** and **YouTube **and the DS Domination site, which taught me about Drop-shipping strategy before. And when I got my first order of an MP3 Player, I was very so happy that i can’t explain it. Now, it’s time to ship it. I used **DTDC Courier Service **at starting but that was so costly, as my product selling price was only Rs.299 and i had to pay Rs.80 for shipping which was too much. So my** **husband told me to find out cheap option so i selected** India Post** for shipping all my orders at that time and i was happy. therefore i was really selling on eBay and making a good profit, but there was a twist… So my **Ebay** seller account got suspended, but I was crazy so I created another account with my husband’s name and that account got suspended, and you won’t believe I created about 7–8 accounts one after one but finally I got fade up with the idea to create more **Ebay** accounts. So I decided to apply for a Valid TIN number and other KYC Documents so that i can submit those to eBay Support Center and get my account back, but the interesting part of this, i can’t get my Ebay to account back, even after i have all valid documents. I just kicked off from that place forever… Now i had TIN Number, All bills, and Authorizations Letters but i don’t have any Seller Account. Then Suddenly I thought about **AMAZON, FLIPKART, and SNAPDEAL**, and i got the jackpot, Created Amazon Seller Account, and Flipkart Seller Account and listed my all products with proper KYC Documents. Within 6 months I made about 8–9 Lacs and i was doing great, many times I got daily orders of more than 200 and I was just reinvesting money in this business. But, life is full of wonder, in 2016–17 PM Modi implemented GST Rules and the whole market crashed, all electronic products were sealed for about 6–8 months, which means there were no products for sale in INDIA. And I was selling mobile batteries, which were not available in India, and previously I was paying sales tax of only 5% which was suddenly increased to 28% the funny thing is that my vendor gave us the Bill at a very low price. Example:- I bought a mobile battery at Rs.200 each with quantity 1000 then I was paying Rs. 200,000 but all the vendors making bills at Rs. 10 each for 1000 quantity so I getting bill of Rs.10,000 only. So almost all the GST Amount was paid by me and i was not getting any increase in selling price. This means I have crusted again, but that was my fault as i didn’t try to figure out other products which were doing great. and now the problem was that i lost my whole earning and profits within the next 6–12 months. So, I was in debt and had no money to invest in AMAZON Again on other products, so I figure out another way of making money from AMAZON as an Amazon Associate or you can say **Amazon Affiliate Marketing** **system, where I can sales others people products with my own particular link as an associate. I reviewed Amazon products in my blog and YouTube channel and I got commissions well and good. Now I had enough money to invest again in AMAZON FBA so I again created my AMAZON Seller account and sold different types of stuff and making good money.
